title: Amended Return Forms TN 2026 (business trust) and TC 2026 (unit/property trust) now listed
publication_date: Not stated (new on HASiL Download Forms 19/11/2026)
summary: HASiL added YA 2026 Amended Return Form entries for business trusts (Form TN) and unit/property trusts (Form TC). They're for viewing only; HASiL says to submit the Malay version with complete attachments. The entries currently link to HASiL's page on the criteria for incomplete return forms rather than to a form PDF. This adds to the 2026 amended return forms reported on 03/11/2026 (TR, CPE and CPP).
